name: Smart Commute & Traffic
description: Compare alternative commute routes, waypoints, and travel times with real-time traffic for Vestaboard.
author: Sneakamaila

provider.title: Data Provider
provider.description: Select routing data provider. TomTom is 100% free with 2,500 daily requests and no credit card required.

api_key.title: API Key (TomTom / Google)
api_key.description: API Key from developer.tomtom.com (Free, no credit card) or Google Cloud Routes API.

country_code.title: Country Code Filter
country_code.description: ISO 2-letter country code (e.g. 'DE', 'AT', 'CH') to restrict address lookups so waypoints stay local.

origin.title: Default Start / Origin
origin.description: Default start address (e.g. 'Musterstr. 1, Berlin'). Used if Route 1 or Route 2 has no specific origin.

destination.title: Default Destination
destination.description: Default destination address (e.g. 'Alexanderplatz 1, Berlin'). Used if Route 1 or Route 2 has no specific destination.

route1_origin.title: Route 1: Origin (Optional)
route1_origin.description: Specific start address for Route 1. Leave blank to use Default Start.

route1_destination.title: Route 1: Destination (Optional)
route1_destination.description: Specific destination address for Route 1. Leave blank to use Default Destination.

route1_via.title: Route 1: Waypoint / Via
route1_via.description: Force Route 1 through this waypoint (e.g. 'A1', 'Kreuz Leverkusen', or address). Routed as a non-stop via-point.

route1_alternative_index.title: Route 1: Alternative Index
route1_alternative_index.description: Alternative route index to choose if no waypoint is specified (0 = primary route, 1 = alternative 1).

route2_origin.title: Route 2: Origin (Optional)
route2_origin.description: Specific start address for Route 2. Leave blank to use Default Start.

route2_destination.title: Route 2: Destination (Optional)
route2_destination.description: Specific destination address for Route 2. Leave blank to use Default Destination.

route2_via.title: Route 2: Waypoint / Via
route2_via.description: Force Route 2 through this waypoint (e.g. 'B3', 'Dormagen', or address). Routed as a non-stop via-point.

route2_alternative_index.title: Route 2: Alternative Index
route2_alternative_index.description: Alternative route index to choose if no waypoint is specified (0 = primary, 1 = alternative 1).

traffic_model.title: Traffic Prediction Model
traffic_model.description: Traffic model used by Google Routes API.

delay_threshold_mins.title: Moderate Delay Threshold (Minutes)
delay_threshold_mins.description: Delay in minutes before traffic is marked yellow/moderate (default: 5).

heavy_delay_threshold_mins.title: Heavy Delay Threshold (Minutes)
heavy_delay_threshold_mins.description: Delay in minutes before traffic is marked red/heavy (default: 15).

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh Interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often to poll travel telemetry. Minimum 60 seconds (default: 300).

demo_mode.title: Demo Mode
demo_mode.description: Simulate live commute telemetry without needing Google Cloud credentials.

route1_duration.description: Travel time for Route 1 in current traffic (e.g. 34m)

route1_duration_mins.description: Travel time for Route 1 as integer minutes

route1_static_duration.description: Typical travel time for Route 1 without traffic delay

route1_delay_mins.description: Traffic delay for Route 1 as integer minutes

route1_summary.description: Road summary for Route 1 (e.g. via A1)

route1_badge.description: Traffic status color tile for Route 1 ({66}=green, {65}=yellow, {63}=red)

route1_status.description: Traffic condition status text for Route 1 (CLEAR, MODERATE, HEAVY)

route2_duration.description: Travel time for Route 2 in current traffic (e.g. 28m)

route2_duration_mins.description: Travel time for Route 2 as integer minutes

route2_static_duration.description: Typical travel time for Route 2 without traffic delay

route2_delay_mins.description: Traffic delay for Route 2 as integer minutes

route2_summary.description: Road summary for Route 2 (e.g. via B3)

route2_badge.description: Traffic status color tile for Route 2 ({66}=green, {65}=yellow, {63}=red)

route2_status.description: Traffic condition status text for Route 2 (CLEAR, MODERATE, HEAVY)

faster_route.description: Identifier of faster route (Route 1, Route 2, or EQUAL)

time_diff_mins.description: Time difference between both routes in integer minutes
